workflow.name: Legal & Compliance Document Archiving
workflow.description: Automates HR contract archiving: validate → duplicate-check → CDN upload → local Drive storage → record upsert → email notification → audit response.

HR_EMAIL.description: HR manager's email address for confirmation notifications

SMTP_HOST.description: SMTP server hostname for sending emails

SMTP_USER.description: SMTP login username (usually the sender email)

SMTP_PASSWORD.description: SMTP login password or app-specific password

workflow_steps.name: validate_and_enrich
workflow_steps.description: Sanitise and normalise all inputs. Generate structured filename and Drive folder path.

workflow_steps.name: check_duplicate
workflow_steps.description: Search for an existing filed contract for this employee. Halt with 409 if found.

workflow_steps.name: upload_to_cdn
workflow_steps.description: Stage the document in local CDN storage and obtain a stable URL.

workflow_steps.name: find_or_create_folder
workflow_steps.description: Resolve or create the storage folder mirroring HR/Contracts/{Year}/{Dept}/{Employee}.

workflow_steps.name: upload_document
workflow_steps.description: Copy the document into the resolved folder with the structured filename.
